correctness.rationale: All stated finite counts and dimensions have explicit, independently replayable certificates. Structural proof rules out VC-shattering five K6 edges; symmetry bounds the positive edge branch by 28 hypotheses and hence Ldim by five. Every finite lower bound has witnessed patterns and a complete decision tree. The connected construction follows rigorously from bridge exclusion and additive product dimensions. Bounds and quantifiers cover n=3..6 and every integer s>=1 only.

value.rationale: The natural family of spanning cycle covers exhibits its first sharp static/online edge-query threshold at K6, with a structural saturated-vertex obstruction and exact depth-five adaptive certificate. The same gap grows without bound across connected simple uniformly bounded-degree graphs, distinguishing two-factor classes from the matroid-basis equality class. The result does not claim a general complete-graph formula.
